spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for sections. Container margins must be substantial.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-2xl for major cards, rounded-lg for inner elements. Avoid sharp corners.

surfaces.interactive_glass: bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.08] hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:border-white/[0.15] transition-all duration-300

components.header: Sticky with crystal_glass. Must have logo, navigation links, and a primary CTA. Never completely transparent.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF4F00] text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-[#CC3F00] transition-colors shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,79,0,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,79,0,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white/[0.05] text-white border border-white/[0.1] px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/[0.1] transition-colors

customizer.canvas_container: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 bg-[#050505] rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.05] overflow-hidden relative flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]
customizer.controls_sidebar: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 crystal_glass p-6 rounded-2xl flex flex-col gap-6 h-full

components.checkout_form: Use Shadcn components customized with interactive_glass. Focus ring must be ring-1 ring-[#FF4F00] border-transparent.
components.admin_dashboard: Control Room Grid. Denser spacing (p-4 to p-6). Less blur, more solid dark backgrounds to ensure data readability. Tables must have clear 1px borders (border-white/[0.05]).

animations.hover: Scale 1.02 on interactive cards. Smooth color transitions (duration 300ms ease-out).
animations.page_load: Staggered fade-up for bento grid items using framer-motion.
animations.marquee: Slow, smooth drift for supported brands using react-fast-marquee. Text style: uppercase, mono_font, text-white/30.

image_urls.description: Abstract misty dark glass texture for immersive landing page hero background.
Silhouette of person holding smartphone, to be used in hero section overlay.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-button', data-testid='customizer-upload-image').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using pure HTML+Tailwind for layout wrappers, and highly customized Shadcn components for interactive logic (.js/.jsx files).
Implement a dark luxury theme matching Archetype 5. DO NOT use generic Inter/Roboto fonts. Setup Clash Display for headings and Satoshi for body.
The Hero Section MUST use the 'hero_background' image with a bg-black/40 overlay. Do NOT use heavy opaque layers that hide the image.
Fabric.js customizer must be large, precise, and wrapped in a 12-column grid (Canvas 8 cols, Sidebar 4 cols).
Inputs and cards must use the 'crystal_glass' or 'interactive_glass' tailwind definitions.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium hardware feel.
Never use purple or teal for accents; stick strictly to the primary #FF4F00 (Orange/Amber) and monochromatic scales.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, links, inputs, and major sections.
Implement an admin dashboard with a denser layout, maintaining the dark theme but prioritizing data visibility.
Ensure the UPI payment screen explicitly instructs users to upload a screenshot and UTR number, styling the manual upload like a premium feature.
